items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: And when Red come in the band, him and Higgenbotham... Well, there was Red, there would be Higgenbotham in it, and there would be Pops Foster, and there would be Albert Nicholas, and there would be Russell

ctx.x: Yeah, Higgenbotham... He wasn't there when I went there, but...
Do you remember who was there on trombone when you got there?
